notes.title: 🐰 Mr. Bunny July Playtest Results – Thank You! 🙏
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]
Just wanted to send out a huge THANK YOU to the brave few who gave the [b]Mr. Bunny[/b] playtest a spin during its first public appearance.[/p][p]We had [b]17 players[/b] start [b]42 runs[/b], and I collected some stats that I think look kinda cool (check out the image below 👇).
Yes, [b]bats were absolutely brutal[/b], and it turns out that most of you didn’t survive long enough to see the boss, but I appreciate every minute you spent with the game.[/p][p][/p][p]🧠 [b]Quick summary of what we learned:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players love the [b]art[/b], [b]audio[/b], and [b]vibe[/b] of the world 🎨🎶[/p][/*][*][p]The game is currently [b]way too hard[/b] early on, most runs ended in the first few rooms 💀[/p][/*][*][p]Key mechanics (sunlight/moonlight effects, shield reflecting, low HP power-up) were [b]not clear[/b] or were often missed.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat feels[b] restrictive[/b] for many players.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477793/7ab6921f8a94a07d6601f908a43ccfe7cc607dc2.png"][/img][/p][p]🛠️ [b]What’s next?[/b]
I’m working on:[/p][list][*][p]A proper [b]tutorial/onboarding[/b] section so players aren’t thrown into the deep end[/p][/*][*][p]Tuning down early-game difficulty (especially those evil bats 😅)[/p][/*][*][p]Improving [b]combat responsiveness.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you [i]barely survived[/i], know you weren’t alone. And if you [i]rage quit[/i], I still love you. ❤️
More updates coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Luismi[/p]

notes.title: Early Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]🚧 [b]Early Playtest Now Live![/b] 🎮[/p][p]Hi everyone!
I'm the solo developer of Mr. Bunny, and I'm opening up the [b]first-ever public playtest[/b] of the game.[/p][p]This version includes the [b]first chapter[/b] of the game and is a work-in-progress demo. It's [b]not fully balanced[/b] yet. I’m expecting things to feel rough in places! That’s exactly why I need your help.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 What to Expect[/h3][list][*][p]A true [b]work in progress[/b] — assets, levels, gameplay... well, pretty much everything is still being developed![/p][/*][*][p]Some [b]fun moments[/b] (I hope!) and a fair bit of [b]frustration[/b] (most likely).[/p][/*][*][p]A game still deep in development, so [b]bugs, unbalanced difficulty[/b], and a general lack of polish are all part of the experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💬 How You Can Help[/h3][p]Once you've played a few runs, head over to the dog in the hub. She is in charge of the feedback! You can fill out a short form there. Totally optional, but your thoughts (even quick ones) really help shape the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Tell me:[/p][list][*][p]What worked?[/p][/*][*][p]What didn’t?[/p][/*][*][p]Was it fun? Too hard? Too weird?[/p][/*][/list][p]This kind of feedback helps me improve the experience and shape the next version.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much for giving it a try.
Your support at this stage means everything.
– Luismi[/p]
